Preconditions: Email is not registered; registration page is available
Steps and Test Data: Register with new.user@example.com and password LibraryPass8
Expected Result: Account is created and registration succeeds

Preconditions: Email existing.user@example.com already has an account
Steps and Test Data: Attempt registration with existing.user@example.com and a password of at least 8 characters
Expected Result: Registration is rejected and a clear duplicate-email error is displayed; no second account is created

Steps and Test Data: Attempt registration with new.short@example.com and password Short7
Expected Result: Registration is rejected because the password has fewer than 8 characters

Preconditions: Catalogue contains known books with distinct titles authors and ISBNs
Steps and Test Data: Search separately using an exact title an author name and an ISBN
Expected Result: Each query returns the matching catalogue record or records

Preconditions: Catalogue contains books with searchable title author and ISBN fields
Steps and Test Data: Search using a partial title author term and ISBN
Expected Result: Each query returns the expected matching records

Preconditions: Representative catalogue is loaded and response timing is enabled
Steps and Test Data: Run title author and ISBN searches under the agreed representative workload and measure request duration
Expected Result: Each search returns matching results in less than or equal to 2 seconds

Preconditions: No catalogue record matches the chosen query
Steps and Test Data: Search for a unique non-existent title such as NoSuchBook-9472
Expected Result: The page displays the exact message "No results found" and no unrelated results

Preconditions: Registered user has no active loans; at least 3 books are available
Expected Result: All three loans are created; each due date is 14 days after its loan date

Preconditions: Registered user already has 3 active loans and no overdue item
Steps and Test Data: Attempt to borrow a fourth available book
Expected Result: The fourth loan is rejected and no extra active loan is created

Preconditions: Registered user has fewer than 3 active loans; requested book is available
Steps and Test Data: Borrow one book and inspect the loan due date
Expected Result: Loan is created with a due date exactly 14 days after the loan date

Preconditions: Registered user has an overdue active loan and fewer than 3 total active loans
Steps and Test Data: Attempt to borrow an available book
Expected Result: The new loan is rejected because an overdue item exists

Preconditions: User has a book loaned and it is returned on or before its due date
Steps and Test Data: Record the return and inspect loan status and book availability
Expected Result: Return is recorded; the loan closes; the book becomes available; fine is P0.00

Preconditions: User has a book loaned; return is 3 days after its due date
Steps and Test Data: Record the return and inspect the fine
Expected Result: Return is recorded; the book becomes available; fine is P6.00 at P2.00 per overdue day

Preconditions: Loan due date is known; email delivery can be captured in a test mailbox
Steps and Test Data: Advance the controlled clock to 2 days before due date and run the notification job
Expected Result: Exactly one due-soon email is sent to the user

Preconditions: Loan is overdue for at least 3 days; email delivery can be captured in a test mailbox
Steps and Test Data: Run the notification job on three consecutive overdue days
Expected Result: One overdue email is sent on each day to the user; no daily notification is omitted
